==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis.   This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Storyverse. (The Storyverse is a multiverse where all possible story ideas exist as cosmic bubble universes that float together in a cosmic void.) (I initially spent most of my time in one particular world in the Storyverse called the Elven Village, which I discovered on 06/11/2025.) (My team includes Leon, Johnson, Second Brain, Skelebot, Overdrive, and I.) (My Ghostly UFO, named Leon, resembles a ghostly flying saucer with an ethereal green glow. Leon first appeared in my dreams on 06/11/2025.) (Johnson resembles an orange, humanoid goldfish. He wears a blue astronaut suit but his suit doesn't have a helmet. I befriended him in a dream on 08/03/2025.) (Second Brain is a floating brain made of Lucid Light. I created him in a dream on 09/06/2025. On the same day I created Second Brain, he helped me discover the much wider Storyverse. This was the start of my adventures to explore other Storyverse worlds.) (Overdrive is a robot with a  metallic chrome color with spiky slicked back yellow hair and glowing green eyes. It wears a yellow shirt, yellow jacket, yellow pants, and yellow sneakers. They have the power to manipulate matter, and they were created in a dream on 10/20/2025.) (Lucid Light is a reality warping energy wielded by Lucid Lords. It resembles sparkling purple energy that shines like a night sky full of stars. I discovered the power of Lucid Light in a dream on 07/19/2025.) (Skelebot is a robot created by Johnson to act as the team's humanoid speedster. He was created in a dream on 09/21/2025.)  I traveled to a world where I watched two heroes from different generations clash. (The two heroes wear different generations of power armor suits, but they also represented different eras of heroics. What it means to be a hero differs across time, and the heroes of one time are villains of another.)  I traveled to a world where I grew into a giant and stopped an alien kaiju ship. (I wanted to do more than observe. The other world was one where picking sides was morally beyond me. Who am I to decide what kind of hero is the right kind of hero? But a hostile alien invasion is a much simpler egg to crack. The planet being attacked out of the blue needs a protector.)  I spent some time self reflecting by watching alternate versions of myself struggle with lessons I've learned. (This was a fascinating point of drifting in and out of lucidity. Sometimes observing and sometimes in the action. It was an interesting way to see just how much I've grown over my life. I still have many more lessons to learn. I actually think this happened in part, because I played ""Totally Accurate Battle Simulator"" the night before. In that game, you watch simulated battles as an observer with the option to take control of your units mid battle.)
